title: RiboSeq Pipeline Parameters
description: Parameter schema for the ribosome profiling pipeline

sample_sheet.description: Path to CSV sample sheet with Run and study_accession columns

star_index.description: Path to STAR genome index directory

fasta.description: Path to reference genome FASTA file (required for RiboWaltz P-site analysis)

ribometric_annotation.description: Path to RiboMetric annotation file (optional, for RiboMetric QC)

adapter_list.description: Path to adapter list TSV file

rrna_index.description: Path to bowtie1 rRNA index directory (e.g., /path/to/rRNA_index) or path to any index file. All *.ebwt files in the directory will be staged for rRNA filtering.

run_organism_setup.description: Run in organism setup mode (only build reference files)

auto_build_indices.description: Auto-build indices if they don't exist

download_method.description: Method to download genome: 'gget' (Ensembl) or 'url' (custom URLs)

gget_which.description: File types to download with gget

genome_fasta_url.description: URL to genome FASTA file (for url download method)

genome_gtf_url.description: URL to GTF annotation file (for url download method)

rrna_source.description: Source for rRNA sequences: 'gtf' (extract from annotation) or 'silva' (download from SILVA)

silva_url.description: URL to SILVA rRNA database (for silva rRNA source)

sample_regex.description: Regex to extract sample ID from filename

annotation_regex.description: Regex to extract annotation type from filename

force_fetch.description: Force reprocessing of existing collapsed reads

collapsed_read_path.description: Path to directory containing pre-collapsed reads

rpf_extraction_method.description: RPF extraction method: 'getrpf' (architecture detection) or 'traditional' (fastp + optional rRNA filter)

getrpf_max_reads.description: Maximum reads for getRPF architecture detection sampling

min_read_length.description: Minimum read length after trimming (for traditional method)

max_read_length.description: Maximum read length (0 = no limit, for traditional method)

bowtie_rrna_mismatches.description: Bowtie -v parameter for rRNA alignment mismatches

mismatches.description: Maximum number of mismatches allowed in STAR alignment

trim_front.description: Number of bases to trim from 3' end

rpf_length_min.description: Minimum RPF length to keep (when filter_by_length is true)

rpf_length_max.description: Maximum RPF length to keep (when filter_by_length is true)

ribometric_sample_size.description: Number of reads to sample for RiboMetric analysis

ribowaltz_exclude_start.description: Number of nucleotides to exclude from start codon in RiboWaltz coverage

ribowaltz_exclude_stop.description: Number of nucleotides to exclude from stop codon in RiboWaltz coverage

normalize_coverage.description: Enable coverage normalization for output tracks

unique_reads_previous_index.description: Path to previous unique reads index (for progressive mode)

run_matrix_mode.description: Build a global unique-reads matrix instead of running per-sample alignment

matrix_align_unique_reads.description: Align the global unique-read FASTA after matrix merge; disable for very large matrix-only runs

matrix_chunk_size.description: Rows per chunk in dense global matrix output

matrix_tsv_chunk_size.description: Maximum unique sequences sorted in memory per FASTA-to-TSV chunk

matrix_metadata_shard_rows.description: Maximum rows per global metadata/read lookup parquet shard

matrix_sparse_shard_rows.description: Maximum nonzero rows per sparse count Parquet part

matrix_sparse_read_bucket_size.description: Number of global read IDs per sparse read_bucket partition

matrix_append_to.description: Existing sparse global output directory or manifest to append as a new generation

matrix_use_partitioning.description: Split unique-read matrix construction by sequence prefix

matrix_partition_prefix_length.description: Prefix length for partitioned matrix construction

matrix_partition_stride.description: Read ID namespace stride reserved for each sequence-prefix partition

matrix_partition_sparse_read_bucket_size.description: Read bucket size used by partitioned sparse count stores

metrics_db.description: Path to DuckDB metrics store (default: results/pipeline_info/qc.duckdb)

emit_both_offsets.description: If true, also build tracks using all-length offsets

run_translonscorer.description: Enable TranslonScorer scoring for QC-passing samples

translonscorer_bam_type.description: Which filtered BAM-derived bigwig to use (matches bam_type meta)

translonscorer_plot_range.description: Plot range around start for reports

translonscorer_pip_spec.description: Custom pip spec for installing TranslonScorer
